utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Vik, did you hear about that repair drive for the Johnson's car? I think it's at the garage on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, I think you might be mixing it up—there's a repair drive this weekend for fixing up old tools and electronics, not a car. The Andersons are bringing their broken blender!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, tools and stuff. Well, I'll probably swing by with my old toaster then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Faye, I just got word that the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead—can you help spread the update?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that's a big change! I was hoping to tie it to school pickup times, but I'll let the other parents know about Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks Faye, I really appreciate you spreading the word—I'll make sure to update the flyers and post on the neighborhood board too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Sam, I keep forgetting — do you know if the repair drive is this Saturday or Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It's Saturday, Oren. I'm planning to be there early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, Saturday, that's right! Thanks, Sam. I'll mark it on my calendar this time — I promise.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Noah, have you heard about the repair drive? I'm helping round up folks and their broken stuff—the Andersons are even bringing their blender!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive! Wait, who's actually doing the fixing? My toaster's been broken for weeks.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Good question—I think a few handy neighbors are volunteering their skills, and we're also collecting tools so everyone can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Ira, I was just thinking—Bo promised to bring his toaster to the repair drive. Are you planning to bring anything for us to fix together?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I've got an old lamp that's been flickering—maybe we can figure that out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds perfect, Ira! Flickering lamps are often just a loose wire or a bad bulb holder—we'll get it sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, you bet! This Saturday we're all getting together to fix up old bikes—I've been spreading the word, and Cleo's already chipping in with spare parts!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I'll bring my wrenches.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Leo! Every wrench counts—see you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, sorry I'm late—did I miss any important updates for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, you're fine. Gus just showed me a tool list—nothing urgent.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good to know. I'll grab my toolbox—Eli said we'd need it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Nell, I was just going to ask if you've heard about the repair drive this weekend! They're fixing up old bikes and appliances—I think it's going to be a great community thing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I've picked up a little from Vik and Rosa, but I'd love to hear your take on it, Tess—what are you planning to bring or help fix?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I'm planning to bring my old toaster—it's been on the fritz for months—and maybe help out with some bike repairs if they need an extra hand!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus, you still need help gathering supplies for that repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh hey Mina, yeah I sure could use a hand—I've got a list running and we're still short on a few things like wrenches and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you have specific brands in mind for the extension cords, or will any heavy-duty one work?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Hana, I like things tidy and predictable, so let me lay out the plan: we'll meet at the community center at 9 AM sharp this Saturday, fix what we can, and have it all wrapped up by noon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds like a solid plan, Eli. Just to make sure: do we have all the necessary tools and materials ready for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Hana, I've already checked the inventory — we have screwdrivers, pliers, and some spare parts ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's good, keeping busy helps. What's the hardest part of the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Probably matching the right person with the right broken item—some fixes are trickier than others, but we always manage!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not great with electronics, but I can handle simple tools if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I heard you're organizing the repair drive—what's the exact location and time again?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, are you sure about this repair drive? I haven't seen any official notices posted anywhere.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm pretty sure I saw a flyer—it's at the garage on Maple and 3rd, starting at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard you're helping with the repair drive. That sounds like a good way to bring people together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's this weekend! We're collecting old tools and electronics to fix up and donate—I think the Andersons are bringing their broken blender!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: A blender, huh? What else have people been bringing in?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane, I'm supposed to bring my toaster to that repair drive on Saturday. You know anything about it?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh hey, Bo—sorry I'm late! Eli mentioned we're gonna have a good crew, so I'm bringing my toolbox. Your toaster should fit right in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I'll make sure to grab it before I head over. Should be a fun time fixing stuff up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, Noah—are you absolutely certain about this repair drive? I haven't seen a single official notice anywhere in the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I think Mara mentioned something about it... but honestly, I'm not sure if it's official or just a plan.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: See? Even you aren't sure. We need something solid before we spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Mina, I haven't found the right socket yet—this is exactly the kind of thing that worries me about the repair drive. If we can't even organize a simple tool search, how will we handle a whole weekend of repairs?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Maybe we should double-check the garage at Maple and 3rd—I thought all the tools were supposed to be staged there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That garage might have the tools, but do we have enough people to actually sort and use them? I'm still worried about our volunteer count.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Sam, I heard something about a repair drive at the store. Do you know what that's all about?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, it's a neighborhood thing where folks bring broken items to get fixed instead of tossing them. I'm helping out—want me to fill you in on the details?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, fill me in! I've got a few things around the house that could use some fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rosa! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up old stuff at the community center—it's gonna be a big help for the neighborhood!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, actually Cleo, I made an update—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center! Hope you can still make it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, thanks for the heads-up, Rosa! Sunday works just as well for me—I'll make sure to bring my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, Oren, good timing! I'm just figuring out the details myself—do you know what tools we might need?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hana! I've been telling everyone—just bring whatever spare parts or tools you've got lying around. Cleo's already bringing screws and old tools!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good to know, Quinn. But do we have a list of the most needed items? I'd hate for people to bring things we can't use.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, the repair drive? I've heard bits and pieces from a few folks. What's the plan exactly?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, we're gathering folks to fix up some shared spaces and a few homes that need a little TLC. I've got a list of tools ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds good. Are neighbors actually showing up for that, or is it just us?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli! You free this weekend to help with the repair drive? The community center could really use a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday morning, 9am sharp—I've got my toolbox ready and a whole list of items folks are bringing in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, glad you're in! I'll rally a few more neighbors too—the more hands, the better.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Leo! Did you catch the news about the repair drive? They're fixing old bikes, appliances, and even offering tips on repairs. You should bring that rusty lawnmower you've been meaning to fix!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm bringing the lawnmower. Need help unloading tools first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect! I can lend you a hand with that — just let me grab my gloves and I'll meet you by the truck.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: The after-school pickup starts at 3 PM, so if we set up the repair drive right there, parents can drop things off while they're picking up their kids.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the after-school pickup! That's a great idea, Faye — makes it real convenient for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'm glad you're on board! Should we set up a table near the pickup line, or maybe right by the school entrance?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Mina! Ready for tomorrow? I've been rounding up folks to bring their broken stuff — Noah mentioned a toaster, so we're off to a good start!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We'll need more than toasters, Mara. Have you got a list of volunteers yet? Pia's worried we'll be short-handed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Don't worry, I've already asked around—Bo said he'd bring his toolbox, and I'm hoping a few more helpers will turn up once word spreads.
